name: Team Bulbasaur: Mountain Descent Vanguard
archetype: Route travel configuration — Sleep status control, Ice coverage, Fighting wallbreaking, and Intimidate physical blunting. No gym duel this chapter.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym battle this chapter. Gym duel core retained from Chapter 16 (Clair's 5v5 Rising Badge duel). All six party members train freely across Route 46 and New Bark Town, elevated to Cap 72 in route-travel configuration.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 72. Sleep Powder shuts down wild threats instantly. STAB Flamethrower and Petal Dance provide dual offensive coverage across Route 46's Rock/Ground encounters.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 71. Ice Beam and Hydro Pump crush Route 46's Graveler and Donphan. Water Absorb provides passive healing against Water-type encounters.
500 BST physical wallbreaker. Crabhammer obliterates Route 46's Graveler and Donphan with super-effective Water STAB.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts physical Attack on entry to defang wild Donphan and Graveler. Glare paralyzes the static Slaking for safe capture.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake and Magnitude via Levitate — invaluable against Route 46's Ground-heavy encounters.
Colossal 160 HP tank. No gym duel restriction this chapter — all 6 members participate in route travel. RestTalk loop provides infinite sustain.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder for safe Slaking capture and route trainer shutdown.
Discharge and Light Screen against aerial Fearow and Gligar encounters.
High Jump Kick physical breaker for Graveler-heavy Route 46 encounters.
